effect: Teaching completed the final goal by passing on both the discovery process and practical skills.
reaction: Explaining the prediction and letting others practise made teaching feel concrete.

mostWorthwhile.text: Turning the remembered animal into an imagined beast was most worthwhile: rearranging familiar features made imagination tangible.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing pigment at the cave was straightforward preparation, but less interesting than making the images.

surprise.text: The cave echo became a song through memory and a chosen rhythm, a connection I had not fully anticipated.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary, though combining stars with pigment offered a fairly literal route to the imagined sky.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the chapter linked simple combinations to imagination and shared learning, and I would be curious to see what the community makes next.
